stories.title: What is Robinhood Chain? The new Ethereum layer-2 for tokenized stocks and meme coins
stories.summary: Robinhood has launched Robinhood Chain, an Ethereum layer-2 network built to support tokenized stocks and meme coins. The network is designed to bring Robinhood's trading products onto a blockchain it controls, rather than relying on third-party chains.
stories.whyItMatters: A major retail brokerage running its own layer-2 network is a concrete step toward tokenized equities becoming mainstream, and it puts Robinhood in direct competition with existing crypto infrastructure providers.
whatToWatch: Which assets and products launch on the chain first
Whether other brokerages follow with their own layer-2 networks
questions: Who controls or validates the network, and how decentralized is it in practice?

sources.title: What Is Robinhood Chain? The Ethereum Layer-2 Network for Tokenized Stocks and Meme Coins

stories.title: Zcash tops $1,000 as its spot ETF assets pass $400 million
stories.summary: Zcash's price broke $1,000 as its spot ETF crossed $400 million in assets under management, according to CryptoSlate. The milestone marks a notable rise in both price and institutional-style demand for the privacy-focused coin.
stories.whyItMatters: Growing ETF assets signal real capital flowing into a privacy coin category that regulators have historically scrutinized more closely than Bitcoin or Ether.
whatToWatch: Further ETF inflow or outflow data in coming weeks
Whether the price holds above $1,000
questions: What is driving the demand — retail speculation or institutional allocation?

sources.title: Zcash breaks $1,000 as its spot ETF crosses $400 million in assets

stories.title: The 'buy, borrow, die' tax trade is quietly building hidden credit risk in DeFi pools
stories.summary: CryptoSlate reports that the 'buy, borrow, die' tax strategy — where holders borrow against assets instead of selling to avoid taxes — is increasingly being routed through DeFi lending pools, adding credit risk that isn't always visible to other pool participants.
stories.whyItMatters: If a tax-driven borrowing strategy concentrates risk in DeFi pools, a wave of forced unwinds or defaults could hit lenders who didn't know that risk was there.
whatToWatch: Any protocol disclosures or risk-parameter changes addressing this exposure
Whether liquidations tied to these positions increase
questions: How large is this exposure across major lending protocols, and is it concentrated in a few pools?

sources.title: How the “buy, borrow, die” tax trade is quietly loading DeFi pools with hidden credit risk

stories.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows hit $3.8 billion in strongest three-week run of 2026
stories.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs pulled in a combined $3.8 billion over the past three weeks, the strongest such stretch so far in 2026, per Cointelegraph.
stories.whyItMatters: Sustained ETF inflows are one of the clearest signals of institutional demand for Bitcoin and can influence price direction more durably than retail trading.
whatToWatch: Whether weekly inflow data extends the streak or reverses
Individual fund flow breakdowns for signs of concentration
questions: Is this inflow driven by new institutional allocators or rotation among existing holders?

sources.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows hit $3.8B in strongest three-week stretch of 2026

stories.title: Dormant Bitcoin wallet that turned $120 into $3 million wakes up
stories.summary: A long-dormant Bitcoin wallet that originally held roughly $120 worth of Bitcoin, now worth about $3 million, has become active again, Decrypt reports.
stories.whyItMatters: Old-wallet movements are watched closely as potential signals of early holders taking profit, and can add sell-side supply to the market.
whatToWatch: Whether the coins move to an exchange, which would suggest a sale
questions: Who controls the wallet, and why did it activate now?

sources.title: Ancient Bitcoin Wallet That Turned $120 Into $3 Million Wakes Up

stories.title: DAOs are forcing crypto protocols to choose between pure code and emergency brakes
stories.summary: CryptoSlate examines how decentralized autonomous organizations governing crypto protocols increasingly face a choice between strict 'code is law' immutability and building in emergency intervention powers, such as pause switches, to respond to incidents.
stories.whyItMatters: How protocols resolve this tension shapes whether DeFi can respond quickly to hacks and bugs, or whether it stays vulnerable in the name of decentralization.
whatToWatch: Specific DAO governance votes on adding or removing emergency controls
questions: Which major protocols currently lack any pause mechanism, and are they reconsidering?

sources.title: DAOs are forcing crypto protocols to choose between code and emergency brakes

stories.title: Fed research flags how stablecoins could get double-counted in M1 or M2 money supply
stories.summary: New Federal Reserve research highlighted a measurement problem: the same dollar backing a stablecoin could potentially be counted twice across M1 and M2 money supply statistics, per CryptoSlate.
stories.whyItMatters: If stablecoins distort official money-supply measures, that complicates monetary policy decisions and adds pressure for clearer stablecoin accounting standards.
whatToWatch: Any Fed follow-up guidance or proposed methodology changes
Reaction from stablecoin issuers or banking regulators
questions: Would a fix require new reporting rules for stablecoin issuers?

sources.title: Fed stablecoin research exposes how the same dollar could count twice in M1 or M2

stories.title: Robinhood rejects AMC CEO's demand to halt its tokenized AMC 'stock'
stories.summary: Robinhood has rejected a demand from AMC's CEO to stop offering a tokenized version of AMC stock, which CryptoSlate reports gives holders no actual shareholder rights.
stories.whyItMatters: The dispute highlights a core tension in tokenized equities: products that track a stock's price without conferring the legal rights of real shares, raising investor-protection questions.
whatToWatch: Whether AMC pursues further legal or regulatory action
Any regulatory response addressing disclosure for tokenized stock products
questions: What rights, if any, do buyers of tokenized AMC shares actually have?

sources.title: Robinhood rejects AMC CEO’s demand to halt AMC tokenized ‘meme stock’ which offers no shareholder rights

stories.title: Solana's plan to cut account deposit requirements by 90% could weaken a reason to hold SOL
stories.summary: A proposed change to Solana would cut the SOL required as account rent deposits by 90%, according to CryptoSlate, reducing one source of structural demand for holding SOL.
stories.whyItMatters: Rent deposits currently lock up SOL across the network; a large cut could ease costs for developers and users but may also reduce a built-in demand driver for the token.
whatToWatch: Whether the proposal advances to implementation
Any analysis of the change's net effect on circulating SOL supply
questions: How much SOL currently sits in rent deposits, and how much would be freed?

sources.title: Solana’s plan to cut account deposits by 90% could weaken a reason to hold SOL

stories.title: Robinhood Chain hit by major outage and corporate backlash at peak growth
stories.summary: Robinhood Chain suffered a significant outage alongside corporate backlash just as the new layer-2 network was seeing rapid growth, CryptoSlate reports.
stories.whyItMatters: Reliability problems this early can undercut confidence in a brokerage-run blockchain meant to host tokenized stock trading, especially while it's still building trust.
whatToWatch: Robinhood's explanation of the outage's cause and any fixes
Whether the corporate backlash leads to product or policy changes
questions: What exactly caused the outage, and how long were users affected?

sources.title: A major outage and corporate backlash hit Robinhood Chain at the peak of its growth

stories.title: Google patches Chrome flaw that hackers were already exploiting
stories.summary: Google has issued a patch for a Chrome vulnerability that was already being actively exploited by hackers, Decrypt reports, and is urging users to update their browsers.
stories.whyItMatters: Crypto users are frequent targets of browser-based exploits used to drain wallets or steal credentials, making prompt updates especially important for this lane's readers.
whatToWatch: Confirmation of whether the exploit was used in any crypto-targeted attacks
questions: Which threat actors were exploiting the flaw, and what was their target?

sources.title: Update Your Browser: Google Patches Chrome Flaw Hackers Were Already Using

stories.title: Poland upholds crypto bill veto as Zondacrypto scandal widens
stories.summary: Poland has upheld its veto of a crypto regulation bill as a scandal involving exchange Zondacrypto continues to widen, Cointelegraph reports.
stories.whyItMatters: The veto leaves Poland's crypto regulatory framework unsettled at the same time a domestic exchange faces a growing scandal, a combination that could shape how the country approaches oversight.
whatToWatch: Further developments in the Zondacrypto scandal
Any revised crypto bill brought back for consideration
questions: What specifically triggered the veto, and what is the Zondacrypto scandal about?

sources.title: Poland upholds crypto bill veto as Zondacrypto scandal widens
